methodology.measured: process RSS over time while one seeded render streams to a WAV file, at 4 durations spanning 48×+; peak via resourceUsage().maxRSS, curve via in-process sampler at block cadence
methodology.granularity: per-render continuous RSS samples + per-point peak; wall clock per render
methodology.trials: 1 render per duration point, each in a fresh child process (isolation by construction)
methodology.warmup: not applicable across points (fresh processes); within a render the first blocks ARE the render
methodology.statistic: per-point RSS curve stats + cross-point linear fit of peak RSS vs duration

observations: Peak RSS vs duration fit: slope 0.35 MB per audio-minute (PCM16 stereo alone would be 10.09 MB/min; category C's chunked path measured ~75 MB/min over 6→60 min). The residual duration-linear term is the kernel event list (~0.2 KB/event), not audio buffers.
